just_intervals.note: measured octave minus 1200 ¢, register to register

progression.narrative: The performance opens on Bb4 and dwells most on G in Phrase 1. Phrase 2 (0:14.2) introduces F, centred on G. Phrase 3 (0:30.0) introduces Ak, Dk, D, Eb, centred on C. The line peaks at G5 (800.6 Hz) at 0:57.4. It closes on the tonic (C4 → Dk4 → C5 → Ak4 → C5 → G4).

theory_fit.name: Pythagorean / Safi al-Din
theory_fit.description: Nearest note of the 17-note gamut generated by pure fifths (±8) from the tonic.
